in_greek.name: Αντών
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Αντών προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'Αντίος', που σημαίνει 'αντίος' ή 'πολύτιμος'. Στο πλαίσιο της παράδοσης Χριστιανική, το όνομα αντανακλά την έννοια του να είσαι πολύτιμος ή ανώτερος.

in_latin.name: Anton
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Anton derivatur ex Graeco 'Αντών', quod significat 'inestimabilis' vel 'pretiosus'. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc reflectit notionem magnitatis et valoris spiritualis.

in_english.name: Anton
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anton originates from the Greek 'Αντών' (Anton), meaning 'inestimable' or 'priceless'. It carries connotations of great value and high esteem. Historically, the name has been used in Christian tradition to signify someone of significant spiritual worth. The name Anton has been borne by several saints and martyrs, adding to its spiritual significance.

The spiritual significance of the name Anton is rooted in its connection to this saint, representing a dedication to a simple and godly life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anton, derived from Antonius, means "priceless one" or "invaluable" in Latin, reflecting the belief in the inherent worth and value of every human being in the eyes of God.

historical_references.reference: Saint Antoninus of Florence, born in 1389, was a Dominican friar and a renowned theologian, preacher, and biblical scholar. He was a close friend and advisor to Pope Leo X.

Saint Antoninus of Padua, born in 1195, was a Franciscan friar, preacher, and doctor of the Church. He was known for his great devotion to the Eucharist and the Virgin Mary, and is considered the patron saint of travelers.
